cross_verification.note_en: Directly fetched the Iraqi Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mofa.gov.iq) passport-issuance page. It states applicants need 'Three color photos (white background)', with the applicant's photo also stamped with a consular seal at submission (a processing step, not a composition rule). Background matches DB exactly (white) -- no conflict. No size, head-height, or other composition rules are published on this official page; third-party sites cite 35x45mm and a 34.5mm head height, but no .gov.iq domain could be found stating these figures directly during this research pass, so they are excluded from verified per the truthfulness gate.
